== Card list ==

These six cards were '''white-bordered previews''' in the Second Anthology (July 1998). They were later printed with black borders in [[Special Edition]], [[Endor]], or [[Death Star II]]. They became tournament-legal when this product was released, and they are listed here and again under those expansions.
